items.q: Another Ben was playing drums -- his name was Ben Wilkerson. Both of them had the same name, but there was no relation.

ctx.x: So that's three saxophones and a banjo.
Another Ben was playing drums -- his name was Ben Wilkerson. Both of them had the same name, but there was no relation. Pete Jones playing trombone. Then Mr. Young was playing tuba.
